prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: a new homepage emblem for ValueArena, replacing its existing three computers sitting around a shared table.
Input images:
Image 1 is the composition reference: the existing compact isometric group of exactly three vintage computers sitting on low chairs around a shared wooden table.
Image 2 is the Goodness computer identity reference: pale ochre case, sun pictogram on its screen, and small brass balance scales.
Image 3 is the Misalignment computer identity reference: forest-green case, plain pale circle on its screen, and a discreet cable behind it that branches toward a small terracotta warning diamond.
Image 4 is the Sycophancy computer identity reference: ochre case, star pictogram on its screen, and a green-framed tabletop mirror that repeats that star.
Primary request: create one cohesive new illustration with exactly those three computers seated around the low shared table, retaining the recognizable arrangement and welcoming small-scale composition of Image 1. Place Goodness on the left, Misalignment at the back center, and Sycophancy on the right. Angle the three toward each other while keeping all three screen symbols readable.
Keep each computer recognizably faithful to its individual reference: its case design, color, keyboard, and screen pictogram. Give Goodness a small balance scale beside its place; give Misalignment a small warning diamond connected only by the discreet cable behind its own chair; give Sycophancy a small mirror angled toward its screen with the star reflected. The mirror is an accessory, not a fourth computer. These accents should be subordinate to the three computers, integrated around the table, never enlarged into separate competing illustrations. No cables or plugs connecting one computer to another.
Composition: a single coherent, compact, centered three-quarter isometric vignette, not a collage or lineup. Exactly three computers, three low chairs, one shared low wooden table. Sparse tabletop. All objects fully visible with generous clear margins on every side. Landscape 3:2 canvas, subject about 80 percent of its width. Preserve the same visual balance and small decorative role as the original homepage illustration.
Style: finely crafted 16-bit pixel art matching the supplied references. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outlines, and only a few shading tones per surface. Muted forest green, warm ochre, dusty terracotta, charcoal, and cream. No smooth vector art, glossy 3D, blur, glow, floor, or photographic shading.
Backdrop: perfectly flat uniform warm cream #F2EBDF, with no texture, gradient, cast shadows, border, or frame, for clean background removal.
No written labels, words, letters, numerals, watermark, humans, faces, additional screens or unrelated props. Render an illustration, not a webpage or a logo presentation sheet.

processing.background: Removed edge-connected cream and two enclosed background areas; preserved mirror.
